cases.title: A signed-in DMG user receives backend Fish voices without provider keys
expectedResults: Desktop login succeeds against the same Render deployment as the public site
The client receives namespaced Fish voices
No provider key is sent to the desktop

cases.title: Fish reading streams through Render and consumes Tristr credits once
expectedResults: The desktop service client receives progressive audio and alignment
Aligned characters reproduce the input
Credits decrement exactly once
proof: Production stream exercised through the shipped desktop transport module

cases.title: Account-backed Fish previews use the service
expectedResults: A Fish preview is collected from the backend into playable MP3 data
Provider errors settle without hanging the UI
proof: Preview success and error unit tests
cases.blocker: Fish preview passed. ElevenLabs preview cannot produce audio until the configured ElevenLabs provider account is funded.

cases.title: Local provider keys remain an explicit direct-mode override
expectedResults: A local Fish key chooses fish-direct
A local ElevenLabs key chooses elevenlabs-direct
Removing keys restores account-backed service routing
cases.blocker: No disposable local provider keys were used for this release QA; the policy is fully automated but direct provider billing was not exercised live.

cases.title: Fish endpoints fail closed and the service key is absent from the DMG
expectedResults: Anonymous requests return 401
Malformed Fish IDs return 400 without a debit
Provider errors are sanitized
The server key is absent from the public package
proof: Backend secret scan and provider-failure fixtures

cases.title: The public v0.1.4 DMG is immutable, notarized, and wired to production Render
expectedResults: Unauthenticated public download succeeds
Published digest matches
Gatekeeper accepts a notarized Developer ID app
The packaged app reports v0.1.4 and contains the Fish service route
The packaged default backend accepts production accounts
proof: Extracted public app.asar executed against production auth and voices
